newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica King Food buys Bimbo's restaurants.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica King Food buys Bimbo's restaurants.

text.p: South African group King Food Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that it had agreed to buy franchised restaurant chain Bimbo's for an undisclosed sum with effect from January 2 next year.
Bimbo's has 34 outlets in South Africa and a central distribution facility which will be absorbed into King Food's similar operation.
"(Bimbo's) is well placed for growth with contracts in place for the installation of outlets in Engen service stations nationwide," said Dennis Finch, King Food managing director.
Earlier this year King Food bought franchise operation Porterhouse and the Bimbo's deal is the second acquisition since the group floated on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange in June.
